name: claude-tools
description: Meta-tooling for Claude Code itself. Includes plugin-config: set, change, and diagnose plugin userConfig values (API keys, tokens, credentials) from the shell instead of the interactive /plugin prompt — with helpers to find where a value is stored (settings.json vs the OS keychain), set it across multiple CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR profiles, and debug why ${user_config.KEY} resolves empty. Also includes handoff: compact the current conversation into a handoff document — printed in chat by default, or saved to a dated file in the current directory with --file, optionally self-contained via --pack — so a fresh agent session can pick up the work.
